summary.name: HubSpot
summary.one_liner: HubSpot is a customer platform combining marketing, sales, customer service, CRM, and AI agent software in one place.
use_cases: track sales leads and manage deals
handle customer support inquiries with AI
find and reach out to prospects
summary.what_it_does: HubSpot offers a set of hubs covering marketing (Marketing Hub), sales (Sales Hub), service (Service Hub), content (Content Hub), data (Data Hub), revenue and payments (Revenue Hub), and a core Smart CRM. It also includes Agent Hub for deploying AI agents and an AEO (Beta) feature that shows where a brand appears in AI results. Built-in AI agents include a Customer Agent that resolves inquiries and hands off with context, and a Prospecting Agent that finds buying signals and launches outreach. The page states it integrates with over 2,000 apps.
notable: Modular hubs for marketing, sales, service, content, data, and revenue under one CRM
Built-in AI agents for customer service and prospecting
Small Business Bundle offering Starter editions of each product at one price
caveats: Page does not state detailed pricing; the directory listing marks it freemium
Claims such as resolving over 65% of inquiries are vendor statements on the page
